rawRules.rule: One Force Point per round is default; individual published abilities can explicitly override; Force Readiness alone does not waive cap.
rawRules.implementation: Persist same-round spend count with authoritative actor/round identity; mandatory preflight and commit recheck.

rawRules.rule: On own turn, ordinary FP bonus to one attack/skill/ability roll is a free action; choose once per round; heroic dice scaling 1d6/2d6 keep high/3d6 keep high.
rawRules.implementation: Bind bonus receipt to a single roll; cancel instead of silently running an unmodified requested paid roll.

rawRules.rule: One spent Power instance can be recovered immediately by spending one FP as a reaction; p93 errata resolves original swift-action typo.
rawRules.implementation: Typed source authorization; validate selected spent recoverable Item ID before spend and commit atomically.

rawRules.rule: One spent starship maneuver instance can be recovered immediately using one FP as a reaction.
rawRules.implementation: Same FP authorization and receipt type, domain-specific selected maneuver instance.

rawRules.rule: Spend FP as a reaction to avoid otherwise fatal damage and fall unconscious per printed death rules; no Force Readiness requirement.
rawRules.implementation: Source-authorized reaction must validate the triggering death-resolution and remaining per-round allowance.

rawRules.rule: As swift action spend FP to decrease DSS by one; only when DSS positive; per-round restriction still applies.
rawRules.implementation: Single guarded FP debit and DSS adjustment; no spend if there is no possible reduction.

rawRules.rule: Force Readiness allows spending FP as a free action even off-turn, but ALL other restrictions still apply.
rawRules.implementation: Off-turn waiver only for free-action spends; do not automatically grant unlimited FP/round or waive descriptor restrictions.

rawRules.rule: At DC18+, Block UTF-enhancing FP spend does not count against one-FP-per-round; DC23+ grants 1 and DC28 grants 2 temporary FP limited to that exact Block UTF spend.
rawRules.implementation: Typed active regimen grant, scoped rollDomain block-activation, exception noncounting, expiring temp entry; reject same entry for Deflect or generic attack.

rawRules.rule: At DC18+, Deflect UTF-enhancing FP spend does not count against one-FP-per-round; DC23+ grants 1 and DC28 grants 2 temporary FP limited to that exact Deflect UTF spend.
rawRules.implementation: Typed active regimen grant, scoped rollDomain deflect-activation, exception noncounting, expiring temp entry; reject same entry for Block or generic attack.

rawRules.rule: At DC33, Block and Deflect check-enhancing FP may be spent off-turn and do not count against ordinary per-round limit.
rawRules.implementation: Scope both waivers to Block/Deflect activation only; never global FP limit override.

rawRules.rule: Temporary/bonus FP availability is determined by the producing source's printed purpose and expiration, not by aggregate pool totals alone. Guardian Spirit code already carries a restrictive note needing source certification.
rawRules.implementation: Spend eligibility per pool entry id and typed restriction; expiry filtered before availability; exact entry amounts saved for potential refund.

rawRules.rule: Core p102 'Force Point Recovery' grants 1 FP spent during encounter at encounter end; official errata removes second paragraph purporting to permit repeated selections.
rawRules.implementation: Treat recovery entitlement per owned technique according to corrected version; do not auto-multiply by obsolete repeated-selection paragraph.

rawRules.rule: Core condition-track step3 is -5 penalty, step4 -10; step5 is helpless. No blanket prohibition on FP spending at step3 is established by this page.
rawRules.implementation: Replace hard-coded >=3 'helpless' assumption in FP service; derive actual legal action capability from canonical condition/action rules.

rawRules.rule: Core p96 prohibits using FP to modify UTF activation check for [dark side] Powers; [light side] UTF activation check similarly forbidden when DSS>=1. Applies to check modification, not necessarily every separate Force Point option.
rawRules.implementation: Power descriptor and DSS check before paid roll; distinguish paid option IDs from roll-enhancement bonus.

rawRules.rule: A source-specific exception must be actually held/active and apply to the requested FP use; a caller-supplied 'allow' boolean alone is not a rule.
rawRules.implementation: Re-derive exception from canonical feat/regimen/effect state server-side at the commit boundary; reject undocumented source strings.

rawRules.rule: At DC38 on Vo'ren's Fourth Cadence, if damaged while maintaining a Force Power, actor may spend one FP as a reaction to avoid the usual fresh UTF concentration check.
rawRules.implementation: Source-scoped reaction authorization tied to an active maintenance/damage receipt, not a generic off-turn waiver; enforce ordinary FP cap unless another source explicitly supersedes it.

rawRules.rule: Official errata allows spending an FP to use Block or Deflect against an attack on an adjacent ally; the Block/Deflect reaction remains subject to all other printed restrictions.
rawRules.implementation: Authorized reaction context includes triggering attack, adjacent target, eligible talent, and exact FP spend. No Force Readiness needed for this source's reaction; count against round limit unless separate exemption.

findings.observation: If requested FP spend fails, RollCore logs a warning but still constructs and executes the ordinary unboosted roll; result marks success rather than failing requested paid option.
findings.fix: Fail closed or prompt to explicitly confirm an unpaid roll; never silently downgrade.

findings.observation: Rollback uses ActorEngine.gainForcePoints() (normal-only). If spend deducted a bonus FP, refund credits normal pool instead of the original bonus entry and restrictions, potentially lost at cap.
findings.fix: Use exact spent-entry receipt (normal + bonus entry ids and amounts), rollback same entries, assert idempotency.

findings.observation: ActorEngine.spendForcePoints mutates resource but stores no round spend ledger or source-scoped exception; direct callers bypass service checks.
findings.fix: Validate source, rule, round and already spent count at mutation commit; journal receipt with actor update.

findings.observation: Pool entries carry restrictions/expiry but both patched availability and spend allocation add/deduct all entries regardless of eligibility. Guardian Spirit has an explicit restricted entry at scripts/engine/talent/guardian-spirit-actions.js:157-162; JATM rules provide even narrower purpose limits.
findings.fix: Authorize each bonus entry by typed provenance and expiry; only eligible pool entries can be consumed; never parse free-text as standalone authority.

findings.observation: Generic validator rejects any marked reaction/off-turn without Force Readiness. Some legacy rescue handlers omit isReaction entirely, so validation may inconsistently reject legitimate reactions or bypass timing validation.
findings.fix: Specific RAW recovery and avoid-death reactions must be whitelisted by validated event source; neither blanket reject nor blanket permission.

findings.observation: Recovery can debit before checking target and death/DSS helper methods debit and mutate consequence separately; failure after payment can strand FP.
findings.fix: Validate exact outcome preconditions; commit mutation + event receipt transactionally or exact compensating rollback.

findings.observation: Djem So caller supplies allowOncePerRoundOverride/source in a third argument but method accepts only (actor,amount); supplied purported override is ignored.
findings.fix: Adopt mandatory typed authorization receipt; validate Djem So printed exception before allowing it, not arbitrary boolean.

findings.observation: Service assumes condition step >=3 is helpless; printed Core p149 maps step3 to -5 penalty, step4 -10 and helpless to step5. It can reject legal FP use at condition step3/4.
findings.fix: Use canonical condition/action capability (not numeric assumption), preserving helpless-specific restrictions only if printed rules support.

findings.observation: Existing static test demands ActorEngine.gainForcePoints(actor, amount) refund; this assertion protects the incorrect normal-only refund behavior and would need replacement.
findings.fix: Replace with execution tests that verify exact bonus-entry restoration and normal/bonus conservation.

findings.observation: ActorEngine returns actualSpent even if less than requested; some callers check only a truthy amount instead of exact requested entitlement.
findings.fix: Commit exact requested amount or none; no paid effect on partial result.

findings.observation: Coordinator only forwards reason and amount to validation, not roll context/action/actor-turn/active regimen; source-specific restrictions cannot be authorized reliably.
findings.fix: Forward typed trusted action/roll/provenance context and resolve actual feat/regimen proof before validation.

findings.observation: ForcePointsUtil.rollForcePoint rolls FP dice and updates DSS but contains no FP debit; no active caller was certified in this pass.
findings.fix: Reachability prove; remove if dead, or route to canonical coordinator if active; do not assume dead.

findings.location: Core Rulebook p102 / official October 2008 errata
findings.observation: Printed Force Point Recovery technique permits repeat-selection in paragraph two, but the official errata removes that paragraph.
findings.fix: Certify repeated selections against corrected policy and avoid multiplying end-of-encounter recovery from superseded text.

transactionDesign.name: ForcePointsService.authorizeSpend + ActorEngine.commitAuthorizedForcePointUse
trustedDerivation: sourceEventId, rollDomain and eligibility must be verified against current actor-owned feat/talent/regimen and actual item/roll IDs; client booleans alone are not proof
ForcePointsService derives whether action may occur off turn and if it counts toward limit
bonus pools selected by typed producing-source rule; expired/ineligible entries excluded
at commit, actor's current resource pools and current round receipt are re-read; no trust in earlier snapshot
transactionDesign.commitPath: Validate -> reserve authorized round slot and source-constrained pool entry -> ActorEngine mutation of normal points/bonus entries and same-round receipt -> execute paid event -> finalize; rollback from EXACT pool entries if event fails pre-finalization.
transactionDesign.concurrency: Single actor-scoped commit lock or mutation transaction; idempotency by event/request ID, atomic actor state and spend ledger. No UI-only time/round gate. Foundry cross-client CAS is not evidenced; GM-authoritative serialized application required before claim of race safety.
transactionDesign.onePerRound: At most 1 counted FP expenditure per actor/round unless a current printed exception explicitly states a particular use does not count; separate zero-count exception receipts remain tracked.

no unless specific permission proves otherwise

guardrails: Do not treat source-specific exception as generic unlimited FP spending.
Do not create a competing Force Point wallet or spend engine.
Do not trust client caller claims for legal off-turn or per-round exceptions.
Do not treat arbitrary free-text restriction as independent canonical rule.
No legacy shims, crosswalks or migrations; clean V2 cutover only after caller coverage.
A purchased roll that fails its FP authorization cannot silently become an unpaid successful result.
Refund exact consumed normal and bonus source entries.
No production actor/compendium/schema mutation at this checkpoint.
